You seize the hanging rope, kick away from your support and swing toward the landing, ready to shoulder aside anyone standing beside it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
A secured rope or hanging fixture, and a visible free landing within 4 squares
Duration
Immediate movement and displacement.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Requires an actual usable support. No automatic extra attack. If the rolled distance cannot reach a safe landing, remain hanging at a reachable position; the DA states the risk before the roll.

Weak
Swing 2 squares.
Standard
Swing 3 squares and push one adjacent creature at the landing 1 square.
Strong
Swing 4 squares; push that creature 2 squares and knock it prone.
